title: Find Stuck Zoho CRM Deals Fast Using Claude MCP #Shorts
description:
Stop exporting Zoho CRM deals to Excel pivot tables. Connect Claude to Zoho CRM via a self-hosted community Model Context Protocol server to interrogate stalled deals live using plain English.

1. In Claude Desktop or web settings, navigate to Custom Connectors and add a remote MCP Server URL.
2. Authenticate via Zoho OAuth and connect to the Zoho CRM Data Insights MCP Server.
3. Prompt Claude in plain English: 'Which deals in Negotiation stage have had no touchpoints for over 14 days?'

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM Community MCP Server
- endpoint: stdio
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.READ
- docs: GitHub - Community Zoho CRM MCP Server Integration

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
